subject: New joiner: Divya Menon
body:
Arjun,

Divya Menon joins Support on 16 November as Support Associate (L1). Laptop request sent to IT. Please schedule her induction.

People Ops

subject: Hiring: backend engineer
body:
Hi Arjun,

We'd like to open one Backend Engineer (L3) role for the Atlas team. Can we post it this week?

Meera

subject: 2027 increment budget
body:
Arjun,

Let's discuss the 2027 increment budget next Wednesday. Please bring the attrition numbers by department.

Rohan

subject: Leave request: 30 November to 4 December
body:
Hi Arjun,

I've applied for leave from 30 November to 4 December in the HR portal. Meera has approved it. Just flagging since it's 5 days.

Riya

subject: HR portal downtime
body:
Hello,

The HR portal will be down for upgrades on Sunday 15 November from 08:00 to 12:00.

IT

subject: Sales incentive question
body:
Hi Arjun,

Two of my team are asking when Q3 sales incentives will be paid. Can you confirm the date?

Kabir

subject: Payroll cut-off
body:
Arjun,

November payroll cut-off is 22 November. Please send leave-without-pay and new joiner details before then.

Neha

subject: Support shift allowance
body:
Hi Arjun,

Can we review the night shift allowance for Support? It's INR 300 per shift and hasn't changed since 2023.

Ananya

subject: Candidates for Backend Engineer role
body:
Dear Arjun,

We have three shortlisted candidates for your Backend Engineer opening. CVs are available on request.

Regards,
TalentBridge Recruiting

subject: Policy review due
body:
Arjun,

The leave policy and the work-from-home section of the handbook are due for annual review by 30 November.

People Ops

subject: Relocation support
body:
Hi Arjun,

I may move to Bengaluru next year. Does Acme offer relocation support for internal transfers?

Sameer

subject: Offsite planning
body:
Arjun,

Let's plan a one-day team offsite in January. Budget is INR 3,000 per person. Can you shortlist 3 venues?

Rohan

subject: Ergonomic chair claim
body:
Hi Arjun,

Is the INR 8,000 home-office allowance still available for an ergonomic chair? I'm confirmed since October.

Pooja

subject: Access review for HR folders
body:
Arjun,

Quarterly access review: only you and Neha currently have access to the restricted HR folder. Please confirm this is still correct.

Vikram

subject: Interview panel
body:
Hi Arjun,

Sameer and I can be on the interview panel for the Backend Engineer role on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Meera

subject: Exit interview: Support
body:
Arjun,

An exit interview is scheduled with a Support Associate on 12 November at 16:00.

People Ops

subject: Gratuity provision
body:
Arjun,

For the year-end accounts I need the list of employees who complete 5 years before 31 March 2027.

Neha

subject: Re: Sales incentive question
body:
Thanks Arjun. I'll tell the team incentives are paid with the November salary.

Kabir

subject: Training request
body:
Hi Arjun,

I'd like to send two Support associates to a de-escalation training (INR 12,000 each). Can it come from their learning budgets?

Ananya

subject: Board pack: people slide
body:
Arjun,

Please send the people slide for the board pack by Thursday: headcount, attrition, open roles.

Rohan
